text: Dr. Da Bai is indeed very professional! Especially in surgery, he's a seasoned pro, top-notch! He's a veteran; you can tell a doctor's skill the moment they start working... restaurant_name: Serenity Clinic Phuket เซเรนิตี คลินิก ภูเก็ต
text:
The staff provided good service and spoke politely. The clinic is new and clean.
This was my first visit. I came for a consultation but didn't get to see the doctor, only the sales representative.
I only got to see the doctor after the surgery was finished, haha.
Customers should be able to consult with the doctor before surgery. I wish the doctor could explain the possible outcomes of the nose and what problems the customer had with their original nose. During my 3-month follow-up, I told the doctor that it seemed slightly tilted to the right. The doctor looked at my photos and said my nose had been tilted from the beginning. I never noticed it before, so I was a little disappointed that I didn't get to see the doctor before the surgery.
I asked the doctor if it could be fixed and if there would be a cost.
The doctor said it could be fixed and the cost wouldn't be much.
As for whether my nose looks good: it's more prominent and has more dimension.
